description: Full read/write across all roles, hospitals, and environments. Only 1-2 assignees; not used for daily ops; PIM planned in a hardening sprint.
Read-only across all roles for demo tours. Cannot invoke agents; cannot open the CSA wizard; cannot mutate state.
Hospital operations lead: cross-department capacity oversight for a single hospital context.
Bed management copilot user: bed state, assignment, and occupancy actions.
Patient-flow manager: transfers, admissions/discharge coordination across wards.
Emergency department lead: ED census, boarding, and admission pressure.
Operating-room coordinator: OR schedule and steering copilot user.
Staffing balance coordinator: shift and staffing-to-demand balancing.
Discharge coordinator: discharge readiness and downstream placement.
Crisis / scenario manager: surge and crisis-scenario copilot user.
Executive: aggregated cross-hospital capacity and value reporting.
Cantonal viewer: read-only aggregated cross-provider view (B2B invite deferred post-sprint).
Platform administrator: platform configuration and operations (non-super).
Ontology steward: semantic model and ontology governance.
AI governance: agent evaluation, safety, and responsible-AI oversight.
Demo operator: drives demo tours with a SIT demo override on hospital context.
Auditor: read-only access to governance evidence and audit trails.
